mock_fit_checks: absolute fitting from saved defaults, without accumulating offsets
unmapped meshes and unassigned joint groups
row-vector matrix cells and rotated-parent local translation math
rollback after cancellation, bind failure, or verification failure
named undo chunk guard and disabled-undo rejection
upper-nose modifiers at saved defaults pass without scene writes
actual nose expressions and neck poses still reject fitting
non-neutral warnings identify connected controls and values
non-finite and out-of-range modifier values are rejected

neutral_modifier_reference_check.condition: All ordinary expression inputs zero, neck/head quaternions identity
neutral_modifier_reference_check.comparison: Both modifiers zero versus both modifiers one, using the original portable evaluator

scope: Define/store vertex attachments, preview translation-only fitting, apply native neutral translations and rest geometry, refresh bind data, verify, and reset. No rotation fitting or expression coefficient adaptation.
remaining_validation: Actual Maya scene/API evaluation, rest mesh installation, bind updates, viewport results, animation playback, and undo must be tested in a saved copy of the user scene.
